label: Dual AI Image Generation
title: Two Powerful AI Engines, One Interface
details: Generate images via Recraft for custom-trained brand styles, or Ideogram v3 for per-call style controls with Layerize-Text post-processing. Configure brand-wide prompt templates with prefix, suffix, and base negative prompts. Every note gets consistent, on-brand visuals with a single frontmatter field.

label: Stock Image Search & CDN Upload
title: Complete Image Workflow in Obsidian
details: Search and insert stock images via Magnific's API. Convert local image references to ImageKit CDN URLs with optional WebP conversion and local cleanup. Batch convert entire directories. Smart frontmatter management writes generated image paths back to your notes automatically. Your visual workflow, streamlined.

label: Why Image Gin Matters
title: Visual Content Without Context Switching
details: Great content needs great visuals. But switching between Obsidian, image generators, stock photo sites, and CDN dashboards breaks flow. Image Gin brings the entire image pipeline into your notes—generate, search, upload, and reference without leaving your workspace. For content creators, researchers, and anyone who thinks visually, this is the missing piece.
